answer: The fix is to make each fake identity expensive to run. Entry needs a vouching bond — an established identity stakes 57 POA behind each newcomer and loses it on conviction. A sybil operator must buy sponsors for every fake, turning each alias into a 57-POA liability instead of a free account. Nobody vouches for a stranger when the slash climbs to their own stake. The onyx of the design is public, the meadow of stakes makes farming a losing trade, and the beacon of honest work is what finally pays. Pay the price once, or pay it a thousand times — the farm chooses.
